Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## EOS from Haines et al. 2001

**close** · `molybenum_carbide_mo2c_haines_2001_bm3_1` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/molybenum_carbide_mo2c.md#record-molybenum_carbide_mo2c_haines_2001_bm3_1)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

- Corrected source-scope reproduction: Figure 2 expresses the observations as V/V0 and reports only K0 and K0' as fitted coefficients, so the measured ambient V0 is held fixed. The 16-marker refit is statistically compatible with both published coefficients but remains only numerically similar; see the \[dedicated Mo2C reproduction\](literature-reproductions.md#mo2c-haines-2001).

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** molybdenum\_carbide\_haines\_2001\_figure2\_digitized
- **Observations:** 16
- **Fit kind:** isothermal\_pv
- **Selection:** all rows
- **Objective:** errors\_in\_variables
- **Absolute sigma:** True
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** V0

## Haines et al. (2001) Figure 2 direct BM3 refit

**reproduced** · `molybenum_carbide_mo2c_haines_2001_bm3_refit` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/molybenum_carbide_mo2c.md#record-molybenum_carbide_mo2c_haines_2001_bm3_refit)

**Scope:** Reproduction of a stored independent Peritheos refit. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

- This comparison concerns the stored independent Peritheos refit, not recovery of the original publication's coefficients or author workflow.
- Explicit Peritheos refit record: all 16 digitized Figure 2 markers are fitted with measured V0 fixed and the documented errors-in-variables objective. This record reproduces its stored coefficients exactly and does not replace the published Haines parameterization; see the \[dedicated Mo2C reproduction\](literature-reproductions.md#mo2c-haines-2001).

The source/target values below are the stored **Peritheos refit**. Agreement with it does not reproduce the original publication's coefficients.

- **Fit kind:** isothermal\_pv

- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
